25th July – 12th September

Tao of Glass

Inspired by a dream, this West End premiere marries ten meditations on life, death and Taoist wisdom with ten brand new pieces of music from Philip Glass, presented by Phelim McDermott with an ensemble of musicians and puppeteers.
★★★★★

‘A transcendent tapestry suffused with joy and wonder’

– The Guardian
★★★★★

‘An intimate, joyful, tender collaboration between McDermott and Glass’

– Bachtrack
Read more
Tickets from £25.00
21st September – 19th December

Who’s Afraid of Virginia Woolf?

FRONT ROW SEATS NOW ON SALE

Set in-the-round and directed by Tony and Olivier Award winner Marianne Elliott (War Horse, Angels in America, Company), this fierce new production draws every spectator right into the eye of the storm…
